name: Kimpton Armory Hotel
positioning: Downtown Bozeman hotel in a former art deco National Guard Armory, with a rooftop lounge and a basement live-music bar (official name Kimpton Armory Hotel Bozeman)
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown Bozeman base steps from Main Street
Guests who bring pets or enjoy live music

facts.text: The hotel is located in the former art deco National Guard Armory in Bozeman.
The hotel is in the heart of downtown Bozeman, steps from the boutiques, restaurants and art deco buildings of Main Street.
Fielding's is the hotel's all-day ground-floor restaurant serving seasonal fare from local growers and purveyors.
Fielding's is named after Fred Fielding Wilson, architect of the original Armory building.
Tune Up is a basement-level whiskey bar with live music.
Sky Shed is a custom glass-enclosed rooftop lounge with views of four mountain ranges visible from downtown Bozeman.
The hotel has one outdoor pool, a rooftop pool overlooking the Bridger Mountain range.
The hotel offers a Pick & Play guitar loaner program with acoustic guitars, in partnership with Gibson.
Pets are welcome at no extra charge, with no size, weight or breed limit.

considerations.text: Valet parking costs 45 USD per night.
The hotel has no local area shuttle and no airport shuttle from Bozeman Yellowstone International Airport.
WhataHotel notes a higher price point typical of boutique properties.
